name: pump_gmm_classifier
summary: Two-component Gaussian Mixture Model that consumes the 10 behavioral features emitted by pump_feature_extractor (parallel agent B) and unsupervised-separates wallets into bots vs humans. Trained model is pickled to studio/assets/_models/pump_gmm.pkl. Cluster IDs are arbitrary at training time; a post-processing step assigns 'bot_cluster' to whichever cluster has the LOWER value_entropy mean (bots emit more uniform trade sizes -> less Shannon entropy). The mapping is persisted into the bundle so downstream consumers (surf executor) don't have to re-derive.
engine_pattern: Train: fit a 2-component full-covariance GMM (sklearn) OR a stdlib EM fallback. Post-fit, compute per-cluster mean feature vector; whichever cluster has the lower value_entropy mean is tagged the bot cluster. Persist both the model and the bot_cluster_id + bot_mean_features. Inference: load bundle, run predict_proba on the wallet's feature row, return (cluster_id, cluster_label='bot'|'human', bot_probability) with a crystal anchor per call.

public_api.train_gmm: train_gmm(features_df, model_out_path=None, random_state=42) -> {model_path, n_samples, bot_cluster_id, bot_mean_entropy, human_mean_entropy, log_likelihood, sklearn_used, crystal}
public_api.bot_cluster_signature: bot_cluster_signature(model_path=None) -> {bot_cluster_id, bot_mean_features, human_mean_features, bot_mean_entropy, human_mean_entropy, n_samples, trained_at, sklearn_used}

features_df: str | pathlib.Path  -> CSV produced by pump_feature_extractor (DictReader)
list[dict]          -> in-memory rows, each with the 10 feature keys + optional 'wallet'
pandas.DataFrame    -> via iterrows() (pandas optional; never imported at module top)
input_acceptance.missing_keys: Any missing/non-numeric feature value coerces to 0.0 — the model still scores but the wallet drifts toward the origin in feature space.

gmm_shape.covariance_type_fallback: diagonal (one variance per feature per component)

sklearn_or_fallback.fallback_trigger: ModuleNotFoundError / any import failure for sklearn
sklearn_or_fallback.fallback_implementation: _StdlibGMM in the same file — ~150 LOC of stdlib only: k-means++ stub for initial means, dataset-wide diagonal variance init, uniform weight init, 50 iterations of E-step (responsibilities via log-sum-exp) + M-step (mean, diagonal variance, weight), early-exit on |Δlog-likelihood| < 1e-4
sklearn_or_fallback.fallback_numerical_floor: variance and weight floored at 1e-6 to avoid log(0) explosions
sklearn_or_fallback.documented_consequence: Fallback is diagonal-covariance only; correlated features get slightly worse separation than full-cov sklearn, but value_entropy still drives the bot/human split cleanly because it's the dominant axis.

post_processing_bot_id.rule: bot_cluster_id = argmin over clusters of mean(value_entropy)
post_processing_bot_id.why: Bots automating trade-size grids emit a small uniform set of (size, time) tuples -> low Shannon entropy on USD value field. Humans exhibit broader, longer-tailed distributions -> higher entropy.
post_processing_bot_id.tie_break: If both means are equal (degenerate / tiny n), cluster 0 wins by default (`<=` rather than `<`).

bundle_schema.feature_names: list[str] — the 10 feature names in order
bundle_schema.sklearn_model_bytes: bytes — pickle.dumps(sklearn GaussianMixture); present iff sklearn_used
bundle_schema.bot_mean_features: dict[str, float] — feature_name -> mean within bot cluster
bundle_schema.human_mean_features: dict[str, float] — feature_name -> mean within human cluster

persistence.directory_creation: studio/assets/_models/ is mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) on first train

training.output_text: {model_path, n_samples, bot_cluster_id, bot_mean_entropy, human_mean_entropy, log_likelihood, sklearn_used} (JSON)

crystal_anchors.graceful: If inference_logger is unimportable, _try_crystal_anchor falls back to a local blake2b hash of the payload so callers always get a non-empty crystal string. Module still works in isolation.

cli_features_arg_parsing: classify-wallet --features accepts strict JSON OR a loose `{tx_per_block:0.5,...}` form with bare keys; the latter is auto-quoted via a regex pass before json.loads.
stdlib_only_guarantee: math (log, exp, pi for log-normal density + log-sum-exp)
Optional: sklearn.mixture.GaussianMixture — used if present, NOT required

pump_feature_extractor.expected_callable: produces a CSV (one row per wallet) with the 10 feature columns + a `wallet` column
pump_feature_extractor.coupling: train_gmm() accepts the CSV path directly; classify_wallet() accepts a single feature-row dict — extractor can call it inline without dumping to disk

surf_executor.expected_consumer: calls bot_cluster_signature(model_path) at boot to learn what feature vector to score live wallets against; calls classify_wallet(features_row) per wallet for the bot probability

inference_logger.purpose: Every train + every classification becomes one record in ~/.cc/inference_master_chain.jsonl — auditors can walk back from a single bot flag to the exact model bundle + the original features that produced it

inbound_callers: pump_feature_extractor (parallel agent B, downstream of pump_stream_ingest agent A)
surf executor (downstream consumer scoring live wallets)
routing_connections.substrate_reads: features CSV from pump_feature_extractor (no DB access of its own)

smoke_test_2026_05_28.synthetic_dataset: 20 wallets: 10 bot-shaped (low entropy ~0.3, high jito_bundle_ratio ~0.9, tight tx_per_block ~0.5, low gas_distortion ~0.05) + 10 human-shaped (high entropy ~2.5, low jito ~0.0, varied tx_per_block ~0.05-0.8, high gas_distortion ~0.5-1.5)
smoke_test_2026_05_28.train_smoke: train succeeds; n_samples=20; bundle written to studio/assets/_models/pump_gmm.pkl; log_likelihood reported; crystal anchor returned
smoke_test_2026_05_28.classify_smoke: TEST_WALLET shaped like a bot is classified as cluster_label='bot' with bot_probability >= 0.85
smoke_test_2026_05_28.sklearn_status: absent on z21 — stdlib EM fallback exercised

guarantees: Stdlib-only baseline — sklearn is optional and gracefully falls back to in-file EM if missing
Deterministic — random_state=42 default means train_gmm on the same features CSV yields the same labels + bot_cluster_id every run

Self-describing bundle — the pickled file carries enough metadata (feature_names, n_components, bot_cluster_id, bot_mean_features) that inspect can reconstruct the bot signature without re-running training
Crystal-anchored — every train + every per-wallet classification logs one row to the inference master chain; if the logger is missing, a local blake2b hash still populates the crystal field
Bot/human label is post-derived from entropy means, not from labeled data — this is an UNSUPERVISED clustering
Graceful missing-feature handling — feature row keys that are absent or non-numeric coerce to 0.0; the model scores rather than throws
limits_v0: 2-component GMM is hard-coded — does not detect sub-populations of bot types (e.g. snipers vs grid-makers) which would need n_components >= 3
Fallback EM uses diagonal covariance — correlated features (e.g. tx_per_block_var vs value_entropy) get slightly worse separation than sklearn's full-cov mode

Bot-cluster identification rule is single-axis (value_entropy mean). If the two clusters happen to have nearly equal entropy means, the call is fragile — surf executor should treat |bot_mean_entropy - human_mean_entropy| < 0.1 as a warning
No incremental fit — every train_gmm call rebuilds from scratch and overwrites the pickle. For streaming retraining, downstream layer must batch features + call periodically
log_likelihood comparison across sklearn vs fallback is not strictly apples-to-apples (full-cov vs diag-cov)

Pickle file is host-portable only insofar as the bundle itself; loading a sklearn-trained bundle on a host without sklearn falls back to uniform [0.5, 0.5] probabilities (deliberate degrade rather than crash)
phase: Agent C of the pump-trading pipeline — sits between pump_feature_extractor (B) and the surf executor (D). Trained once per feature-window snapshot; queried per live wallet from D.
